utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Good morning to everybody in and around the courtroom. Mr. Registrar -- Madam Registrar, will you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. Good morning everyone in and around the courtroom. This is case number IT-04-81-T, the Prosecutor versus Momcilo Perisic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you so much. Could we have the appearances for the day, starting with the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MS. CARTER
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours, gentlemen of the Defence. The Prosecution is here represented by April Carter, Barney Thomas, and Carmela Javier.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you so much. And for the Defence.

utterances.speaker: MR. GUY-SMITH
utterances.text: Good morning to all. Boris Zorko, Chad Mair, I'm going to introduce Amitis Khojasteh who is our new intern.

utterances.speaker: MR. GUY-SMITH
utterances.text: And I'm Gregor Guy-Smith on behalf of Mr. Perisic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Guy-Smith. Yes, Mr. Guy-Smith.

utterances.speaker: MR. GUY-SMITH
utterances.text: Yes, could we move into closed session, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: May the Chamber please move into closed session.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, we are back in open session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you so much. Yes, Mr. Guy-Smith.

utterances.speaker: MR. GUY-SMITH
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour, as I indicated we had only those two witnesses for the day. That is the extent of the presentation of the Defence has for the day. I believe that the next scheduled appearance, if I'm not mistaken, is on the 6th of December.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: That's right. Thank you very much. Court adjourned to the 6th of December. Court adjourned.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Monday, the 6th day of December, 2010, at 2.15 p.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 11.44 p.m.
